message:
The build completed. Now let me build the fuzz target. Let me check what's available:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && ls -la .libs/ 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---" && ls -la fuzz/*.o 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && which $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE 2>/dev/null; echo "LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE=$LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE"; echo "CC=$CC CXX=$CXX CFLAGS=$CFLAGS CXXFLAGS=$CXXFLAGS"'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
